newsitem.title: USA: Xerox completes buy of Rank Xerox.
newsitem.headline: Xerox completes buy of Rank Xerox.

text.p: Xerox Corp. said Monday it has completed the $1.5 billion acquisition of Rank Xerox with the purchase of the remaining 20 percent stake in the company held by Rank Group Plc.
Xerox now has complete ownership of the manufacturing and marketing organisation for Europe and parts of Asia and Africa.
Rank Xerox will change its name to Xerox Ltd., Xerox said.

Xerox said Rank Group shareholders on Monday approved the deal, valued at 940 million British pounds, or about $1.5 billion. Xerox said June 6 it would suspend a $1 billion stock buyback programme to help pay for the acquisition.

Xerox said it paid the Rank Group 500 million pounds ($831.5 million) at the closing Monday. The company said it would pay the balance of 220 million pounds ($365.9 million) in two instalments: half within one year and the other half at the end of two years from Monday.
The company added it could pay an additional 60 million pounds ($99.8 million) in the year 2000 "based on achievement of significant Rank Xerox earnings growth targets by 1999."
Xerox earned $270 million, or 75 cents a share, in the first quarter, compared with $237 million, or 65 cents a share, in the year-ago period.
Xerox's stock fell 12.5 cents to $78.75 in consolidated trading on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-afternoon.
